(First Revision)
0. FOREWORD

Timber Sectional Committee had been approved by the Civil Engineering Division Council.

0.1 This Indian Standard (First Revision) was adopted by the Indian Standards Institution on 27 February 1967, after the draft finalized by the

0.2 This Indian Standard was first printed in 1963 and ccvered volume With tables for the sizes of converted timber specified in IS : 1331-1958*. the revision of IS : 1331-1958* in view of the adoption of metric system and for rationalizing the sizes of converted timber specified in the standard, the need for revision of the volume tables has been felt so as to cover the sizes specified in IS : 1331-1966t. 0.3 Assistance has also been rendered by the valuable data supplied by the Director, Weights and Measures Cell, Ministry of Commerce, Govwmnent of India. 0.4 All the quantitres given in this standard have been rounded off in accordance with IS :,2-l 960:.

1. SCOPE 1.1 This standard provides tables for volume of cut sizes of timber covcrcd by IS : 133 I- 1966t. Lengths from 30 to 500 cm are covered in steps of 5 cm. Volumes are given in cubic metres correct up to five decimal places.

* Specification for cut sizesof timber. t Specificationfor cut sizesof timber (revised). $ Rules for rounding off numerical values (rev&~). 3
